content.text: Mandy and Allan Cameron rescue a Piegan boy, then learn that the aristocratic Chief Onawata—“Copperhead”—is plotting an uprising. Cameron and Inspector Dickson fail to arrest him at the Piegan camp; Copperhead burns the ranch, but Mandy survives. Cameron later pursues him through Calgary, the Sun Dance Canyon, and Indigenous reserves while Mandy, Moira, Dr. Martin, Smith, and allies support the rebuilding of the ranch. Moira and Martin fall in love; outlaw Raven saves her from a runaway wagon and later dies helping Cameron stop a cattle stampede. During the wider 1885 rebellion, Cameron captures Copperhead after escaping captivity with Jerry. The Police prevent a western Indigenous uprising, while the appended diary shifts abruptly to 1865 American Civil War news, Lincoln’s assassination, Booth’s death, Davis’s capture, church life, and local social observations.
